description: Provenance for the datasheets behind E1 hardware selection. Records where each document came from, when it was retrieved, and the digest of the bytes that were read - so a later reader can tell whether the specification a decision rested on is the specification still published. Datasheets are provenance for a nominal figure; they establish no installed-system behaviour, which is what E1 measures.

policy.copyright: Manufacturer documentation is not copied into this repository. Only the source reference, retrieval time, and content digest are recorded. Where a local archive exists outside the repository, local_archive_ref names it without making it the identity.
policy.identity: The sha256 of the retrieved document is the durable identity. source_url may rot; the digest does not.
policy.empty_state: An empty entries list is the accurate state until a component is selected. No placeholder datasheet is recorded for an unselected part.
policy.retrieval: Every digest here is the SHA-256 of the bytes actually served at source_url, retrieved with an HTTP client and hashed unmodified. No digest is computed over a rendered, extracted, or HTML-to-Markdown representation of a document - that would be a digest of something that is not the manufacturer's document. A source that could not be retrieved as a document is cited in the selection rationale as supporting information and is not a member of this manifest.
policy.distributor_sources: Distributor pages establish current price, stock, and lead time. They are not technical authority and do not appear here. Technical claims trace to manufacturer documents only.
policy.local_archive: local_archive_ref is null for every entry: retrieval was to an ephemeral working directory that is not preserved. The digest is the durable identity, which is the point of recording it.
policy.operator_copy_crosscheck: operator_copy_verified is true where an operator-supplied local copy of the same document was hashed and found byte-identical to the bytes retrieved from source_url. It is a cross-check, not an identity: the digest above is still the retrieved document, and the local copy is not archived here. The field exists because a specification the operator read and a specification the repository recorded being provably the same file is worth stating; where they had differed, the retrieved document would still be the record and the divergence would have been written into technical_role. Absent on entries predating DO-108P, where no local copy was offered.
policy.candidate_coverage: covers_candidates is declared, never inferred. A document covers a candidate only where that candidate's specification actually rests on it. An empty list means the document was retrieved during the survey and informed a rejection rather than a selection.

entries.technical_role: Host platform: 40-pin GPIO header carrying the I2S interface the ADC board mounts to

Establishes the binding acquisition limits: 2.1 Vrms maximum unbalanced input, -12 to +32 dB input gain, 44.1-192 kHz, and the 'low-jitter dual-domain clock' wording that does NOT establish DAC/ADC sample-lock
Force sensitivity 500 mV/lb (112.41 mV/N), +/-10 lb range, 0.01 Hz to 36 kHz, 22.7 g mass, 10-32 female both ends - the numbers the force-chain level budget is computed from

entries.document_title: Battery-Powered Signal Conditioner for ICP Sensor specification sheet
entries.technical_role: Unity gain, 0.05 Hz to 500 kHz, 3.25 uV rms broadband noise, 25-29 VDC / 2.0-3.2 mA excitation - single-channel conditioner candidate

entries.document_title: Four-channel ICP Sensor Signal Conditioner manual
entries.technical_role: Four-channel unity-gain conditioner, +/-10 V output capability - conditions force and a CCP microphone from one chassis
10 N force rating, DC-18 kHz, 18 g moving mass - sets the maximum force the transducer chain must represent without clipping
400 W, 38 V rms max output, 18 A peak current limit - reference-grade amplifier candidate

entries.document_title: 1/2 inch CCP Free-field Standard Microphone Set
entries.technical_role: Reference-grade response microphone candidate. Requires CCP/IEPE (4 mA, 24 V), NOT 48 V phantom - the interface conflict with the OPA1612 preamp path
Phantom-powered measurement microphone candidate (24-48 V, 10 mA) - compatible with the existing OPA1612 phantom preamp path
75 VA into 3 ohm, 10 Hz-20 kHz +/-0.5 dB, 40 dB gain, current limit 1-5 A rms with an explicit instruction to limit to 1.8 A for the 4810 - the manufacturer pairing the shaker requirement asks for

entries.document_title: DAEX25CT-4 Coin Type 25mm Exciter 10W 4 Ohm specifications
entries.technical_role: Commercial-prototype exciter candidate: 4 ohm nominal, Re 3.6 ohm, Fs 306 Hz, Mms 1.29 g, BL 1.54 Tm, 10 W RMS. The published frequency response is a foam-core panel response, explicitly qualified by the manufacturer as depending on the driven surface - it establishes no behaviour on a soundboard

entries.document_title: DAEX25FHE-4 Framed High Efficiency 25mm Exciter specifications
entries.technical_role: Commercial-prototype exciter candidate: 4 ohm nominal, Re 4.3 ohm, Fs 224 Hz, Mms 1.61 g, BL 3.63 Tm, 24 W RMS. Higher BL and higher moving mass than the DAEX25CT-4 - which of those matters on a plate is an empirical question, not a datasheet conclusion. Same foam-core response qualification

entries.document_title: EX 30 S Technische Daten / Technical Data
entries.technical_role: Commercial-prototype exciter candidate, electrodynamic bending-wave plate exciter: 8 ohm nominal, 10 W maximum long-term power per DIN EN 60268-5, 20.5 mm voice coil, 40 g net weight. The document publishes no BL, Mms, Fs, Re, Qts or Cms - the absence is the record, and none of those values is derived elsewhere

entries.document_title: TPA3116D2 15-W, 30-W, 50-W Filter-Free Class-D Stereo Amplifier Family With AM Avoidance
entries.technical_role: Reference implementation family for the commercial excitation output stage - CANDIDATE, not a selection. Establishes the properties the requirement document cites: 4.5-26 V supply, selectable 20/26/32/36 dB gain, PLIMIT power limit, MUTE, SDZ, FAULTZ fault reporting, differential and single-ended inputs, 32-pin HTSSOP 11.00 x 6.20 mm body
